p: snare on Mizpah: The priests and princes caught the poor people in their snares, as the fowlers did the birds, in these two high mountains.
slaughter: Even though they seemed to be given altogether to holiness, and to sacrifices which here he calls slaughter in contempt.
rebuker of them all: Though I had admonished them continually by my Prophets.
Ephraim: They boasted themselves not only to be Israelites, but also Ephraimites, because their King Jeroboam came from that tribe.
pride of Israel doth testify to: Meaning their condemning of all admonitions.
strange children: That is, their children are degenerate, so that there is no hope in them.
a month devour them with their: Their destruction is not far off.
Benjamin: That is, all of Israel that was included under this tribe, signifying that the Lord's plagues would pursue them from place to place until they were destroyed.
known that which shall surely be: By the success they will know that I have surely determined this.
remove the bound: They have turned upside down all political order and all manner of religion.
commandment: That is, after King Jeroboam's commandment, and did not rather follow God.
the Assyrian: Instead of seeking for remedy from God's hand.
Jareb: Who was king of the Assyrians.
